conditions: Both operands are interface values with identical dynamic types, and that dynamic type is not comparable.
limitations: Different dynamic types or a nil interface operand do not satisfy this condition. This does not make arbitrary equality expressions statically legal.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum, correction, or material counterexample.

statement: In Go 1.23, evaluating a valid equality comparison of two interface values with the same incomparable dynamic type causes a run-time panic.
